title: DreamVLA: From Generated Human Motions to Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Policies

release_status.value: Official project page provides selected simulated rollouts and reported results; full method code, dataset and checkpoints were not verified.

evidence_boundaries: All reported evaluations are in simulation on a single embodiment.
Expert and VLA scores differ; reported walk-and-pick is 75.95% expert and 18% student.
Button success requires right-index contact in paper Table 1.
The matched offline control matches trajectory count, not demonstrated equality of frame counts.
Paper v1 tables and project-page summary differ for some drawer and button scores.
Task-specific motion constraints, trajectories, rewards and success filters are retained.
